data.text:
I’ll join Jack: 15 tons this month, with all $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, provided John and Emma make the same commitment and Luke catches zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, but protecting our neighbors matters too. This exception needs to stay an exception.

I also commit to no more than 6 tons next month, then 10 once the lake is back at 100. Let’s share catch totals and donation receipts so we can hold one another to the agreement. Emma, are you willing to join us on those terms?
